## About
Parth Mahadik is a software developer and Computer Engineering undergraduate at Trinity College of Engineering and Research (TCOER), Pune. He builds full-stack web applications, AI-integrated solutions, and real-world software systems.

---

## Featured Engineering Projects

### 1. AgroRent
- **Description:** AI-assisted farm machinery rental marketplace connecting farmers with equipment owners through accessible, transparent workflows and multilingual communication.
- **Technologies:** Python, Flask, Google Gemini API, Twilio, Razorpay.
- **Live Demo:** https://agrorent-v3.onrender.com/
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/ParthMahadik33/AgroRent-v3

### 2. AquaTrace
- **Description:** Maritime intelligence and oil-spill investigation platform combining satellite-data workflows, vessel-track correlation, geospatial analysis, and spill-dispersion simulations.
- **Technologies:** Next.js, TypeScript, Python, Flask, Leaflet.
- **Live Demo:** https://aqua-trace-olive.vercel.app/
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/ParthMahadik33/Aqua-Trace

### 3. ARRA (Autonomous Rail Response Agent)
- **Description:** Autonomous railway safety and incident-response simulation platform designed to detect track hazards, assess risk levels, coordinate emergency multi-agent responses, and stream real-time operational alerts.
- **Technologies:** Python, AI Agents, Real-Time Simulation, Event Dispatch.
- **Live Demo:** https://arraproject.netlify.app/
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/ParthMahadik33/A.R.R.A
